result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The carousel and bottom clipping are excluded as intended behavior. A few real defects remain: the bottom navigation is overlapped by the system gesture bar and has no labels or active state, the '15–25 min' badge is misaligned on the first carousel card, and there are minor contrast and consistency issues.

issues.description: The system gesture/home indicator bar overlaps the bottom navigation icons. It cuts through the search icon and the orders icon, so the icons are partly obscured and their tap targets are compromised.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area inset padding so the navigation bar sits above the gesture indicator.

issues.description: The bottom navigation shows icons only, with no text labels. The active Home tab is indicated only by color, so the icons are ambiguous and hard to tell apart.
issues.suggestion: Add text labels under the icons and give the active tab a stronger indicator than color alone.

issues.description: On the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké), the '15–25 min' badge overlaps the plate image and looks slightly misaligned compared with the other cards. The badge is also tight against the card edge.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent badge positioning and padding across cards, and keep the badge from covering the food image.

issues.description: The secondary gray text ('€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen', '(500+)') has low contrast against the white background. The heart icons on the dark image overlays are also small and the semi-transparent circle behind them is faint.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG 4.5:1 contrast, and increase the contrast and size of the favorite buttons.

issues.description: The food imagery is flat illustration-style art, and the pizza card's '-20%' badge has no context. The '€0 delivery' pill on the ramen card also duplicates the €0 delivery text below it.
issues.suggestion: Use real photography, clarify what the discount applies to, and remove the redundant delivery info.
